title: Intelligence
text:
Intelligence (or Int) is one of three attributes, along with Strength and Dexterity. Intelligence is required to equip most energy shield-granting armour, as well as all caster weapons, traps, and some martial weapons, and their associated skills. 


== Base stats ==
Characters start with a certain amount of base intelligence based on their character class.

Pure intelligence character classes (Witch and Sorceress) start with 15 Intelligence.
Hybrid intelligence character classes (Templar, Druid, Shadow, and Monk) start with 11 Intelligence.
All other non-intelligence character classes start with 7 Intelligence.
Intelligence provides an inherent bonus of +2 maximum mana per 1 intelligence.
The following removes the inherent bonus from Dexterity. Note that effects that improves inherent bonuses from attributes such as Enhanced Effectiveness does not scale these modifiers:
